preconditions.description: The size of the broom n must be between 2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n and ui != vi for ui, vi, xi in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices within the range of 1 to n and must not connect a vertex to itself.

preconditions.expression: all(xi.islower() and len(xi) == 1 for ui, vi, xi in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge labels must be single lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum size of the broom after simplification and the integer p chosen.
The minimum size of the broom after simplification must be at least 1.
The integer p must be a positive integer.
